description: Header file defining classes and enums for Bluetooth AVDTP signaling and socket communication, including Payload, Signal, and Socket classes with methods for handling Bluetooth signaling over L2CAP channels.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents AVDTP payload data, derived from DataRecordBE, with builder and inspector function types.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Represents AVDTP signaling messages with enums for signal identifiers, error codes, message types, and packet types; manages serialization/deserialization and payload inspection.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth AVDTP signaling and transport channels, handles signaling requests/responses, and manages channel state and MTU settings.

classes.name: ResponseHandler
classes.description: Handles responses for signaling, invoking acceptor or rejector callbacks.

classes.name: CommandType<ADMIN>
classes.description: Template class for managing signaling commands, requests, and responses over a socket.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a signaling request with methods to set various command types.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a signaling response, used for accepting or rejecting signals.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes signaling data into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into signaling data.

methods.name: AsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the signal.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets signal parameters, including label, identifier, type, and payload.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a signaling request with optional payload.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Rejects a signaling request with optional error code and data.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Abstract method to handle channel operational state changes.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in channel state, updates MTU, and calls Operational.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches signaling requests to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when outbound data is updated.
